name: Aurora Arc Hero
description: A dark centered agency hero with a glowing aurora arc behind the content, an 'open for projects' status pill, a headline with slanted brand highlight blocks, a book-a-call CTA (avatar + button), and a bottom trust bar with an avatar stack, star rating, client count, and a faded logo row.
interactions: on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview) the pill, heading, sub, and CTA fade up in sequence (wpmn-zv-up 500-600ms, staggered 80/160/240ms)
the aurora arc breathes its opacity (wpmn-zv-breathe 6s) and the status dot pulses (wpmn-zv-pulse 1.8s)
the primary button shifts background on hover; the trust bar and logo row fade at the right edge with an alpha mask
prefers-reduced-motion: reveals shown in place, arc and dot animations off
